entries: The LS Car Meet includes a Test Track where supported vehicles can be driven away from normal Freemode traffic. Rockstar also uses the space for Car Meet activities and race-related features.
Street Race Series is part of the Los Santos Tuners content and focuses on street-based competitive racing connected to the LS Car Meet ecosystem.
Pursuit Series races were introduced with Los Santos Tuners as another LS Car Meet race category, built around street racing while dealing with police pursuit pressure.
GTA Online includes Radio Wheel customization so players can reduce clutter by choosing which supported stations appear in the radio selection wheel.
Media Sticks are music collectibles introduced as part of GTA Online content. Finding supported sticks can unlock music mixes for use in the game.
Bail Enforcement Offices provide a higher-value Most Wanted target alongside standard bounty targets. Rockstar describes the Most Wanted target as a recurring high-value bounty opportunity.
Bail Office owners can hire Agents and send them on their own work. Their completed work adds income to the owner, and Agents also reduce processing time for secured bounty targets.
Bail Enforcement work can involve securing a target alive for processing or eliminating the target and delivering the result as instructed by the mission.
Salvage Yard Robberies are multi-stage vehicle theft operations tied to the Salvage Yard. Target vehicles and available robbery content rotate according to Rockstar's current scheduling.
The Salvage Yard supports Tow Truck Service work, where the player recovers vehicles for the business. Availability depends on owning the relevant Salvage Yard equipment.
FIB Files are multi-stage scores unlocked by the Garment Factory. They can be sourced through Jodi and launched from the factory computer or the Darnell Inc. phone app in Freemode.

The Garment Factory's FIB Files include a Priority File that can be completed on its stated weekly cadence for an increased reward. Because rewards rotate, Franklin should not quote a current amount without a current source.

Garment Factory ownership can unlock Bureau Tech modifications for an owned Terrorbyte. Rockstar lists a Master Control Terminal, Collectible Scanner, Silent Running, and Missile Lock-On Jammer among these options.
Silent Running is a Bureau Tech Terrorbyte modification. Rockstar describes it as removing the stationary Terrorbyte from other players' maps while the feature is active.
The Terrorbyte Collectible Scanner is a Bureau Tech upgrade that displays nearby collectibles while driving the Terrorbyte.
Money Fronts laundering operations build Heat. Rockstar says Heat can be reduced by completing legitimate work associated with the laundering businesses.

QuickiePharm Medical Courier is repeatable Freemode work added with Money Fronts, built around delivering medical supplies for GTA$ and RP. Rockstar notes that it cannot be started while part of an Organization or Motorcycle Club.
high value goods delivery gta online
Safeguard Deliveries are repeatable Freemode jobs involving high-value goods. Rockstar notes that these jobs cannot be accessed while the player is part of an Organization or Motorcycle Club.
The Mansion AI Assistant can fast travel the owner to supported owned properties and businesses, making the Mansion a central management and travel hub.
A Mansion's AI Assistant can temporarily increase production speed for a chosen eligible business. This is a timed boost rather than a permanent global production increase.

Mansion Security staff can reduce the chance of owned businesses being raided. Rockstar says the risk can be eliminated for an applicable business when the Mansion security benefit is combined with that business's own Security upgrade.
how many cars mansion gta online
Mansion basement levels include garage space for 20 vehicles. An optional Vehicle Workshop can also be purchased for modifying Personal Vehicles.
The optional Mansion Armory provides a Mk II Weapon Workshop, weapons for purchase, and a gun rack for managing weapon loadouts.
Mansion owners can purchase a cat and a dog that appear around the property as part of the Mansion customization system.
Mansion basement amenities include a private Nightclub separate from the player's normal Nightclub business property.
The Kortz Center Heist uses Prep Missions launched from the Art Studio planning board. Rockstar also allows Prep Missions to be launched by calling Raf De Angelis in Freemode.
Artwork stolen in The Kortz Center Heist can be sold for profit or displayed in an owned Mansion according to the 2026 update notes.
The expanded Mission Creator supports Warp Points, allowing mission designers to move players between configured locations as part of custom mission flow.
The expanded Mission Creator can place functional CCTV cameras. Actors and cameras can also be configured to ignore players wearing specified outfits, enabling custom stealth mechanics.
The 2026 Mission Creator supports multiple custom cutscenes, including camera attachments, timing controls, objective text, mission flags, and player tasks during cutscene sequences.

Mission Creator Actors can be assigned behavior and task logic. Newer Creator updates add shared follow paths, task invalidation, more actor choices, animation options, and support for multiple melee attackers.
Mission Flags are logic states used by the modern Mission Creator. They can be set at defined moments, including during cutscenes, and can trigger or invalidate later mission behavior.
The Mission Creator supports score limits and point-awarding entities, allowing custom missions to progress or finish when configured scoring conditions are met.

Mission Creator supports team outfits and alternate outfits that can be changed during a mission. Newer settings can also preserve the current outfit through Quick Restart unless the creator disables that behavior.
The expanded Mission Creator can test a mission starting from a selected objective, which helps creators debug later sections without replaying the whole mission from the beginning.
Random Transform Races switch players between different vehicle types during the course. Rockstar added more Known Unknown and Unknown Unknown variants in the 2026 Title Update 1.73 line.
Cayo Perico Motor Wars is a Cayo Perico variation of Motor Wars added to GTA Online during the 2025 update cycle.
Cayo Perico Survival is a Survival activity set on Cayo Perico that Rockstar has featured as seasonal GTA Online content.
Hao's Special Works provides high-performance vehicle upgrades on supported newer platforms and editions. HSW availability is platform-specific and should not be assumed on every GTA Online version.
missile lock on jammer gta online

Selected vehicles can receive a Missile Lock-On Jammer through supported vehicle workshops, preventing normal homing missile lock-on. Availability depends on the specific vehicle and supported property or update.

GTA+ is Rockstar's optional GTA Online membership on supported platforms. Benefits can include rotating in-game rewards, services, discounts, and a recurring GTA$ membership bonus. Benefits and platform availability change, so current details should be checked with Rockstar.
Career Progress is a structured challenge system on supported newer GTA Online platforms. Content is grouped into tiers with objectives and rewards tied to specific activities.

The Interaction Menu includes service controls for large owned vehicles. Rockstar has grouped systems such as the Terrorbyte, Avenger, Mobile Operations Center, and Galaxy Super Yacht under Services-related menus.

Weekly GTA Online bonuses, discounts, event rewards, and rotating targets change too often to keep safely as static knowledge. Franklin should direct players to current Rockstar event information instead of inventing a current value from an old title-update snapshot.

Official GTA Online knowledge and iOS-port support are separate. A Rockstar feature such as Bunker, Nightclub, Cayo Perico, Agency, or a business should only be described as available in the iOS port when the project's own release notes or developer knowledge explicitly confirm it.
does ios port use rockstar servers

The 29 Oct iOS project notes describe friend sessions running directly on players' devices and explicitly say there are no project-hosted game servers. Do not describe this as the same backend as Rockstar's official GTA Online service unless the developer later documents that change.

Franklin should distinguish two knowledge domains: Rockstar's official GTA Online systems, used for general GTA Online explanations, and the iOS project's 29 Oct multiplayer implementation, used for claims about what actually works in this port.
